column1: # COAWST's bundled examples that use only ROMS and/or SWAN (pinned commit),
# as run by the examples sweep (README.md). Tab-separated columns:
#   name     run folder and image tag
#   project  folder in the COAWST tree
#   app      cpp application (header = lower-case app .h in the project)
#   mode     coupled (input: the coupling file), roms (ocean file) or
#            swan (SWAN input files, comma-separated, one per nested grid)
#   layout   coupled: "TI TJ NWAV"; roms: "TI TJ"; swan: "NWAV"
#   minutes  simulated minutes, or - for the length the input files give
